verdict.rationale: There is no explicit bulk-action feature in the evidence. Bulk-style work is only implied: rules (up to 1000) automate workflows across incoming conversations, and the REST API and MCP server act on conversations, labels and drafts. An AI agent can summarize the inbox or triage new conversations against a CRM. The API is also rate-limited to 5 concurrent requests and 300 per minute, which constrains large batch jobs. Missing for 10: documented multi-select bulk actions in the UI, batch or bulk API endpoints, any documentation of an AI agent applying one action across many items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
